In the Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought, if this model was destroyed by those attacks, you can use this ability. If you do, roll one D6, with +2 to that roll if this model was engaged with an enemy warlord unit:

- On a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
- On a 6+, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

characteristics.$text:
In your Command phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:


- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- The assault doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine until the start of your next Command phase.

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
Start of your opponent's Movement phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:


- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- When an enemy unit within 6" makes a fall-back move, that enemy unit must take a leadership roll. If that test is failed, that enemy unit must Remain Stationary.
